schema: §2.7 (v0.50) -- complete per-sentence segment disposition, superseding §21 R6's not_annotatable-only shape. `not_annotatable` (R6's original array, the only key run_scoring.load_not_annotatable() reads) is preserved for scoring and holds every NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING / NOT_ANNOTATABLE / EXCLUDED span. `dispositions` is the full per-sentence record §2.7 requires, covering ANNOTATED and AMBIGUOUS spans too.

reconciliation.note: S1 is a heading fragment carrying no modal, no finite verb and no subject+predicate, so it is not a clause in §2.6's sense -- the same shape as E03-037's '5.1Confidentiality.' and locked E02-006's 'b) ', absorbed rather than logged as a class of its own. S2 is the segment's only modal-bearing sentence and yields exactly ONE item: its trailing 'and do all such other acts...' is a sweep-up clause with no determinate content of its own, ruled NOT a second performance under §4.3 (see C04-09's annotator_notes for the full ruling and why the span-collision argument is corroboration rather than the ground). Segment clause count 1, within §2's 1-3 band.

dispositions.reason: Section heading fragment. No modal, no finite verb, no subject+predicate -- verified by execution, not by eye. Carries no span of its own outside the annotated one.

Covers locked item C04-09. The sentence's trailing catch-all ('and do all such other acts...') is INSIDE this span and is deliberately not a separate disposition: it was ruled the same performance's scope stated broadly, not a second clause.
dispositions.span_text: Each Party will execute, acknowledge and deliver such further instruments, and do all such other acts, as may be necessary or appropriate in order to carry out the purposes and intent of the Agreement.
